name: IR obstacle sensor (FC-51 / TCRT5000-style)
description: Infrared LED + photodiode + comparator: OUT goes LOW when something is closer than the trigger distance (set with the blue knob, about 2 to 30 cm; prop threshold). VCC → 3.3 V or 5 V, GND → GND, OUT → a digital pin (it has its own pull-up). On a robot in a world, the physics measures the distance on the side set by mount, like the HC-SR04.

pins.label: OUT
pins.description: LOW = obstacle, HIGH = clear (10 kΩ pull-up to VCC on the module, open-collector comparator).

props.label: Distance to object
props.description: Distance to the nearest object in front. 0 = nothing there. A world with physics overrides it with a raycast.

props.label: Trigger distance (knob)
props.description: OUT goes LOW for a white object closer than this.

props.label: Object surface

options.label: Black / matte dark (≈ 20 % of the range)

props.description: IR reflectivity of the object: dark surfaces are seen much later.

props.label: Mounted on
props.description: Direction it looks on a robot. Used by the robot physics only.

footprint: FC-51 module, 31 × 14 mm, 3-pin 0.1 in header (OUT GND VCC), IR LED and photodiode at the far end

bindings.description: Something is within the trigger distance (OUT LOW).
Distance to the object it sees (cm, 0 = nothing).
